integrity: All finite checks are exact, but general claims rest on the proof; independent historical and mathematical validation was not performed. The dated 2011 source concerns the model; the 1998 and 1999 publications are earlier, without a verified day-level original release date.
scientific_limitations: Exact conditional depth law for uniform rooted plane trees only; no nesting of complete conditioned trees; older Dyck-path enumeration literature, especially Deutsch 1999, carries residual priority risk owing to limited full-text access. Asymptotic regimes hold only under stated hypotheses.
title: A second-order-statistic law for leftmost-leaf depth at a fixed leaf count
